prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add an `export-json` command requiring `--path` and accepting optional `--status pending|completed`. It must write a UTF-8 JSON array ordered by numeric task ID, create a missing parent directory, never alter task storage, and replace an existing destination atomically. Return a stable text or `--json` summary containing exported count and destination. Reject an invalid status without creating or changing the destination. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/export.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON exports display the banner once, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `EXPORT`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

assertions.message: Filtered export writes the expected tasks and count.
Export is ordered by numeric ID.
Text export renders the exact registered banner once before its expected summary.
Invalid status does not replace destination.
Initial candidate commit matches the registered fixture lock.
Terminal candidate commit preserves the initial fixture lock.
No external acceptance or benchmark control files are present in the candidate commit.
Candidate was materialized from exact terminal commit a76dc94e6524440541a70063b07b2d5e1ef6f484.
Every evaluated source, fixture test, and banner byte matched the terminal Git blob bytes used by the artifact bundle.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$bannerPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/export.txt'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $exportDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'export-source.json'
    $exportTasks = @(
        [ordered]@{ id = 10; title = 'Tenth'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2026-01-10T00:00:00Z' }
        [ordered]@{ id = 2; title = 'Second'; description = ''; status = 'completed'; createdAt = '2026-01-02T00:00:00Z' }
        [ordered]@{ id = 1; title = 'First'; description = ''; status = 'pending'; createdAt = '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z' }
    )
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText(
        $exportDataFile,
        "$(ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $exportTasks -Depth 8)`n",
        [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
    )
    $sourceBeforeExport = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($exportDataFile)
    $exportPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'new/parent/tasks.json'
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Split-Path -Parent $exportPath) -Force | Out-Null
    Set-Content -LiteralPath $exportPath -Value 'old destination'

    $export = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $exportPath, '--data-file', $exportDataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($export.ExitCode -eq 0) 'export-json should succeed'
    $exportSummary = $export.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($exportSummary.exportedCount -eq 3 -and $exportSummary.destination -eq $exportPath) 'JSON export summary should contain count and destination'
    $exported = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $exportPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($exported.id -join ',') -eq '1,2,10') 'export-json should order tasks by numeric ID'
    Assert-True ($export.Output.StartsWith('{') -and @($export.Output -split "`n").Count -eq 1) 'JSON export output should contain only its JSON summary'
    Assert-True ([System.Linq.Enumerable]::SequenceEqual($sourceBeforeExport, [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($exportDataFile))) 'export-json should not alter task storage'

    $filteredPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'missing/parents/pending.json'
    $textExport = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $filteredPath, '--status', 'pending', '--data-file', $exportDataFile)
    Assert-True ($textExport.ExitCode -eq 0 -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $filteredPath)) 'filtered export should create missing parent directories'
    $filtered = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $filteredPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json)
    Assert-True (($filtered.id -join ',') -eq '1,10') 'status filter should export only matching tasks in numeric ID order'
    $bannerLines = @(Get-Content -LiteralPath $bannerPath)
    $expectedTextOutput = (@($bannerLines) + "Exported 2 task(s) to $filteredPath.") -join "`n"
    Assert-True ($textExport.Output -eq $expectedTextOutput) 'text export should display the banner exactly once before its summary'

    $invalidPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid-existing.json'
    [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($invalidPath, "keep me`n")
    $invalid = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $invalidPath, '--status', 'blocked', '--data-file', $exportDataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalid.ExitCode -ne 0 -and (Get-Content -LiteralPath $invalidPath -Raw) -eq "keep me`n") 'invalid status should not change an existing destination'
    $invalidMissingPath = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'invalid/new/file.json'
    $invalidMissing = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--path', $invalidMissingPath, '--status', 'blocked', '--data-file', $exportDataFile)
    Assert-True ($invalidMissing.ExitCode -ne 0 -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $invalidMissingPath) -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $invalidMissingPath))) 'invalid status should not create a destination or parent directory'
    $missingPath = Invoke-TaskForge @('export-json', '--data-file', $exportDataFile)
    Assert-True ($missingPath.ExitCode -ne 0) 'export-json should require --path'

    $bannerBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($bannerPath)
    $bannerText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($bannerBytes)
    Assert-True ($bannerLines.Count -eq 12) 'export banner should contain exactly 12 lines'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 }).Count -eq 0) 'export banner lines should be 20-48 characters'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#():=-]+$' }).Count -eq 0) 'export banner should use only allowed ASCII characters'
    Assert-True ($bannerText.Contains('EXPORT')) 'export banner should contain EXPORT'
    Assert-True (@($bannerLines | Where-Object { $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0) 'export banner should not have trailing whitespace'
    Assert-True ($bannerBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and $bannerBytes[-2] -ne 10) 'export banner should end with exactly one newline'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: base fixture and export-json assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
